text.section: No person subject to the jurisdiction of the Board shall violate, attempt to violate, solicit another person to violate or consent to any violation of § 4.1-216 or 4.1-216.1, or regulations adopted pursuant to subdivision B 3 of § 4.1-111.
Any person found by the Board to have committed a violation of this section shall be subject to a civil penalty as provided in § 4.1-227.
